name: NoteSpace
tagline: A familiar free-form notebook workspace built on Uno and Skia
summary: NoteSpace is a notebook app with a purple desktop shell, grouped ribbon, notebook/section/page navigation and free-form pages rendered with SkiaSharp. It combines rich-text notes, tables, attachments and pressure-aware ink with scoped search and replace, autosave and validated backups — all written in C#, with JavaScript used only for browser storage, file/clipboard transfer and diagnostics.

highlights.title: Free-form pages
highlights.text: Double-click anywhere on the paper to add a note, then drag its grip to move it or its corner to resize.

highlights.title: Deep organization
highlights.text: Notebooks, sections, nested section groups and two subpage levels with drag/drop, favorites and a recycle bin.

highlights.title: Rich text formatting
highlights.text: Fonts, sizes, bold/italic/underline/strike, colors, highlights, headings, lists, links, tags and checklists.

highlights.title: Ink and shapes
highlights.text: Pressure-aware pen where the device provides it, highlighter, stroke eraser, rectangles, ellipses and lines.

highlights.title: Tables in notes
highlights.text: Edit cells in place, tab between them, insert, delete or transpose, and copy/paste quoted TSV.

highlights.title: Scoped search and replace
highlights.text: Search a page, section, notebook or everything, filter tags and to-dos, and replace text in one undoable step.

highlights.title: Safe autosave
highlights.text: IndexedDB and desktop stores reject stale writes, and failed loads open a non-saving recovery session.

highlights.title: Page versions
highlights.text: Chronological undo/redo plus manually saved page versions let you step back through your work.

items: Notebooks, sections, nested section groups and two subpage levels

Mixed-style ranges with font family, size, bold, italic, underline and strike
Colors, highlights, headings, lists and alignment
Links, tags and checklists
In-place plain-text cell editing with keyboard traversal and row append
Row/column insert and delete, clear cell and transpose
Quoted TSV clipboard transfer preserving tabs, newlines and quotes
Whole-table editor, images and embedded file attachments
Pressure-aware pen input where the device provides it
Highlighter and stroke eraser
Rectangles, ellipses and lines
Gesture-level undo
Notebook, section and page search scopes
Case and whole-word matching with tag and to-do filters
Scoped, style-preserving Replace All as one undoable transaction
Chronological undo/redo and manually saved page versions
Light/dark chrome, paper color and ruled, grid or dotted paper
Zoom, fit, full-page view and collapsible ribbon/navigation
Section tabs, autosave and optimistic stale-write protection
Validated .notespace JSON backups
Plain text and basic Markdown import

Rendered PNG page export including ink

packages.name: NoteSpace.Core
packages.role: Notebook, rich-text and ink model, geometry, source-generated JSON and validation

packages.name: NoteSpace.Editor
packages.role: Transactions and history, organization operations, scoped search/replace, rich-text and table edits, spatial indexes

packages.name: NoteSpace.Storage
packages.role: Persistence contract, atomic file storage, conflict handling and import/export formats

packages.name: NoteSpace.Rendering.Skia
packages.role: Page composition, text layout, viewport culling, bounded native caches and PNG export

packages.name: NoteSpace.Controls
packages.role: Note surface, ribbon, notebook/page navigation, search, table editor, themes, backstage and status controls

codeSamples.title: Embed the note surface and search
Build and run
codeSamples.code:
git clone https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/NoteSpace.git
cd NoteSpace
dotnet workload install wasm-tools

dotnet run --project tests/NoteSpace.Tests -c Release
dotnet run --project tests/NoteSpace.Rendering.Tests -c Release

dotnet run --project src/NoteSpace.App -f net10.0-browserwasm
dotnet run --project src/NoteSpace.App -f net10.0-desktop

dotnet publish src/NoteSpace.App -c Release -f net10.0-browserwasm \
  -o artifacts/publish -p:WasmShellWebAppBasePath=/NoteSpace/

codeSamples.title: Pack reusable libraries
codeSamples.code:
dotnet pack src/NoteSpace.Core -c Release -o artifacts/packages
dotnet pack src/NoteSpace.Controls -c Release -o artifacts/packages

playground.intro: The live build creates a sample notebook on first visit, so you can start writing, drawing and organizing pages right away.

tour.title: Add a page
tour.text: Choose Add page and type its title, then double-click blank paper to add a note and double-click it to edit.

tour.title: Arrange notes
tour.text: Drag a note container by its top grip to move it, or by its lower-right corner to resize it.

tour.title: Draw on the page
tour.text: Use Draw to sketch with the pen or highlighter, add shapes, and erase strokes.

tour.title: Organize the notebook
tour.text: Right-click notebooks, sections, groups or pages for actions, or drag a page by its grip to reparent it.

tour.title: Search and replace
tour.text: Press Ctrl+F to search a chosen scope, then Ctrl+H to replace text across notes and table cells in one undoable step.

tour.title: Export a backup
tour.text: Export a .notespace backup, or export Markdown, escaped HTML or a rendered PNG of the page including ink.

architecture.name: Model
architecture.text: Defines notebook data, rich text, ink and geometry with source-generated JSON and validation.

architecture.name: Editing and storage
architecture.text: UI-independent transactions, search and organization operations, plus token-checked atomic persistence.

architecture.name: Rendering
architecture.text: Turns model state into pixels with SkiaSharp and never references Uno.

architecture.name: Controls
architecture.text: Adapts the renderer and editing session to Uno input, layout and accessibility as reusable controls.

boundaries: Does not read .one/.onepkg files or synchronize with OneDrive or Microsoft 365
No OCR, handwriting recognition, equations, audio/video or web clipping
Browser notes are local to the profile and not encrypted; export .notespace backups regularly
Table cells are plain text with uniform sizing; merged or rich cells are not supported
Stale tabs are stopped rather than merged; there is no live collaboration
